ai_review.summary: base 0.16 line is entirely below fix 5.4.3 (coverage-dominant affected); a Gentoo _p3 backport of a 5.4.3-era fix is implausible given the version gap
FIPS is orthogonal to the default-provider PKCS7_verify bug; base 3.4 is affected below 3.4.6 and the string does not indicate >=3.4.6; confirm exact patch with 'openssl version -a'

CORRECTED: the vulnerable subsystem was introduced long after 0.16. 0.16.46 is an upstream commit (6ed7a85, 2018-10-11) whose tree_data.h/parser.c use the old lyd_attr architecture; struct lyd_meta and lyd_parser_set_data_flags (the CVE's UAF site) do not exist and appear only in the 2.x rewrite. The CVE range <5.4.3 is historically over-broad. Supersedes the earlier LIKELY_TRUE_POSITIVE which wrongly leaned on version-in-range without introduction-timing.
